snippet.title: Island of the Ancients Game: Trailer 01
snippet.description:
A single-player third-person / first-person action-adventure shooter set on a mystical island in the Bermuda triangle.  With a companion by your side, fight your way through scores of deadly creatures. 

A Child's destiny turns a family vacation into a treacherous adventure of a lifetime.  Fight for your life against terrifying creatures as you unravel the mystery of an ancient island where things are not as they seem.  Discover locations and creatures hidden for centuries.  Collect powerful new weapons and enlist the help of companions from unexpected places along the way.  Your family's survival is at stake.

Configure your family group however you like with multiple choices for each.

25 unique levels with over 60 unique enemy types.  Over 20 different guns to master.

Features full day/night cycle and dynamic weather systems.  DLSS Supported.

Steam store page link:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1650150/Island_of_the_Ancients/
